acceptance_criteria.Given: The paper fingerprint intake program (PRVDEAD1) is initiated
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the program identification banner 'PRVDEAD1: PAPER FINGERPRINT INTAKE (LEGACY)' to notify users that this is the legacy paper fingerprint intake process

rules.rule_description: The system evaluates whether paper fingerprint card processing is currently enabled before allowing any paper fingerprint card to be accepted and queued.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:

Eligibility Check
Is paper fingerprint card

acceptance_criteria.Given: The paper fingerprint intake program (PRVDEAD1) has been initiated and the program identification banner has been displayed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks the paper fingerprint processing enabled flag (WS-PAPER-FP-ON)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the flag is set to TRUE (enabled), the system proceeds to log and queue the paper fingerprint card to the mailroom queue; if the flag is set to FALSE (disabled), the system redirects users to use the LiveScan electronic system instead

rules.rule_name: LiveScan Redirection When Paper Processing Is Disabled
rules.rule_description: When paper fingerprint card processing is disabled, the system must notify users that the paper-based process is no longer active and direct them to use the LiveScan electronic fingerprint submission system.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
3:LiveScan Redirection Notification
Notify users that paper-based process
is no longer active and direct them
to use LiveScan electronic system

acceptance_criteria.Given: The paper fingerprint intake program (PRVDEAD1) has been initiated and the paper fingerprint processing enabled flag (WS-PAPER-FP-ON) is set to FALSE (disabled)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the paper fingerprint processing eligibility check and determines that paper processing is not enabled
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'PRVDEAD1: PAPER PROCESS DISABLED - USE LIVESCAN' to notify users that paper-based fingerprint submission is no longer active and that LiveScan must be used as the approved fingerprint submission method, and the program terminates without processing any paper fingerprint card

rules.rule_name: Paper Fingerprint Card Mailroom Queue Registration
rules.rule_description: When paper fingerprint processing is enabled, the system logs and registers the submitted paper fingerprint card into the mailroom queue for further physical handling.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
4:Paper Fingerprint Card Mailroom
Queue Logging
Log and register paper fingerprint card
submission into mailroom queue

acceptance_criteria.Given: The paper fingerprint intake program (PRVDEAD1) has been initiated and the paper fingerprint processing enabled flag (WS-PAPER-FP-ON) is set to TRUE (enabled)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the submitted paper fingerprint card
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'PRVDEAD1: LOGGING PAPER FP CARD TO MAILROOM QUEUE' to confirm that the paper fingerprint card has been logged and registered into the mailroom queue for further handling

rules.rule_name: Paper Fingerprint Card Session Count Tracking
rules.rule_description: Each time a paper fingerprint card is successfully queued to the mailroom, the system increments and displays a running count of all paper fingerprint cards queued during the current session.

acceptance_criteria.Given: A paper fingerprint card has been successfully logged and registered into the mailroom queue during the current session
acceptance_criteria.When: The system completes the mailroom queue logging for the paper fingerprint card

rules.rule_name: Paper Fingerprint Card Processing Feature Eligibility Check
rules.rule_description: Before any paper fingerprint card intake workflow begins, the system must evaluate whether the paper fingerprint card processing feature is currently active. Based on this evaluation, the system either proceeds with paper card intake or redirects to LiveScan notification.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Paper Fingerprint Card Processing Feature Enabled?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Paper Fingerprint Intake (Legacy) process has been initiated
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the Paper Fingerprint Card Processing feature flag (Paper FP On/Off switch)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the feature flag is enabled, the system proceeds to log the paper fingerprint card to the Mailroom Queue; If the feature flag is disabled, the system redirects and notifies that paper processing is unavailable and LiveScan must be used instead

rules.rule_name: Paper Fingerprint Processing Disabled - LiveScan Redirection Policy
rules.rule_description: When the paper fingerprint card processing feature is turned off, the system enforces the use of LiveScan as the only accepted fingerprint submission method by blocking paper intake and issuing a redirection notification.

acceptance_criteria.When: The Paper Fingerprint Card Processing feature flag is found to be disabled
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must block paper fingerprint card processing and display a notification instructing that the paper process is disabled and LiveScan must be used as the fingerprint submission method

description:
PRVDEAD1 is a legacy batch program originally designed to handle paper fingerprint card intake for high-risk providers. The program checks a hardcoded flag (permanently set to 'N') to determine whether to process paper fingerprint cards; since the flag is never enabled, the paper card processing logic is effectively unreachable and the program only displays a message directing users to use the LiveScan electronic fingerprinting system. This program has been functionally obsolete since the state transitioned to electronic LiveScan fingerprinting in 2019 and is no longer referenced or scheduled by any job.
- **Execution Environment**: Batch - **Database Access**: None - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Paper Fingerprint Intake Initiation - Display program identification banner indicating this is the legacy paper fingerprint intake process for high-risk providers 2: Paper Fingerprint Processing Eligibility Check - Evaluate whether the paper fingerprint card processing feature is enabled or disabled before proceeding with any fingerprint intake workflow 3: LiveScan Redirection Notification - When paper fingerprint processing is disabled, notify users that the paper-based process is no longer active and direct them to use the LiveScan electronic fingerprinting system instead 4: Paper Fingerprint Card Mailroom Queue Logging - Log and register a paper fingerprint card submission into the mailroom queue for processing (legacy workflow, discontinued in 2019) 5: Paper Fingerprint Card Count Tracking - Maintain and display a running count of paper fingerprint cards that have been queued to the mailroom during the current processing session (legacy workflow, discontinued in 2019)
